native.name: Native Template
native.description: Authored directly in TinixCut or built-in library (.tinixtpl / builtin catalog). Full fidelity, full parameter bindings, lossless serialization.

recreated.name: Recreated Native
recreated.description: Manual recreation of external motion styles using pure TinixCut domain primitives (grapheme stagger, 2 outer strokes, double shadow, linear gradient).

full_converted.name: Full Conversion (CapCut Scope Option 1)
full_converted.description: Exact import of evidenced StaggeredCharacterIn family (slide + bounce/rotation, gradient, stroke, shadow, Roboto-Bold font). Zero fidelity loss.

partial_converted.name: Partial Conversion
partial_converted.description: Unsupported animation curves or multi-effect styles mapped to static layout with itemized loss warning; editable text preserved.

baked_reference.name: Baked Video Reference
baked_reference.description: Unconvertible proprietary shaders, 3D text meshes, or third-party sticker effects retained as read-only background video layer.

capcutImportMatrix.scopeDefinition: FULL only for evidenced StaggeredCharacterIn sample; other families PARTIAL/UNSUPPORTED with itemized losses.

families.notes: Exact 29 graphemes, 21-char vertical slide + 3-char bounce/rotation, 118-deg gradient, 2 outer strokes, 2 shadows.
Mapped to built-in FadeIn/SlideIn animation presets.

families.lossItem: Curved path geometry mapped to horizontal line; motion approximated with typewriter or static.
3D meshes cannot be edited natively in 2D pure-Rust rasterizer; imported as baked video reference.
Audio waveform analysis trigger deferred; text imported as static title.

cli.determinism: Bit-for-bit identical to MCP tool responses and native UI commands

mcp.reconciliation: ADR-005 initially documented 8 tools for Phase 15; Phase 35 added 4 template tools (template_validate, template_preview, template_apply, template_save). Total is now 12 authoritative tools.

stylingCapabilitiesMatrix.outerStrokes: SUPPORTED (Up to 4 ordered layers, circular dilation, widest-to-narrowest)
stylingCapabilitiesMatrix.dropShadows: SUPPORTED (Up to 4 ordered layers, separable gaussian blur, offset X/Y)
stylingCapabilitiesMatrix.backgroundBox: SUPPORTED (Rounded corners, padding, opacity, custom fill)
stylingCapabilitiesMatrix.glow: UNSUPPORTED in Phase 29 domain (approximated via zero-offset blurred shadow)
stylingCapabilitiesMatrix.textExtrusion3D: UNSUPPORTED (out of scope for 2D editor v1)
